records.jp: やった……倒せた！
records.en_original: Yes! We beat it!
records.en_auxiliary: Yes! We beat it!
records.en: We did it... We beat it!

records.jp: やったね、ヒナちゃん！
records.en_original: We did it, Hina!
records.en_auxiliary: We did it, Hina!
records.en: We did it, Hina-chan!

records.jp: すごい……本当に殲滅できた
records.en_original: Wow... We really destroyed it.
records.en_auxiliary: Wow... We really destroyed it.
records.en: Wow... We really defeated it for good.

records.jp: ふっ、私の“力”のおかげってところかしら
records.en_original: Hmph. All due to my power.
records.en_auxiliary: Hmph. All due to my power.
records.en: Hmph. I suppose you have my 'power' to thank.

records.jp: 何よ、面白くなさそうな顔ね。私のことを気に入らないんだろう<CR>けど、礼くらい言ってくれてもいいんじゃない？
records.en_original: Don't act so unimpressed. I know you don't like me, but you could at least thank me, don't you think?
records.en_auxiliary: Don't act so unimpressed. I know you don't like me, but you could at least thank me, don't you think?
records.en: What is that face? I know you don't like me,<CR>but the least you could do is thank me.

records.jp: あなた一人の力じゃない。<CR>ヒナちゃんやみんなの協力があったからできたこと
records.en_original: It's not your power alone. We owe our victory to Hina and the help everyone else offered us, too.
records.en_auxiliary: It's not your power alone. We owe our victory to Hina and the help everyone else offered us, too.
records.en: It wasn't your power alone.<CR>We succeeded because Hina-chan and everyone else helped too.

records.jp: あら、そう。じゃあ次からは私が協力しなくてもいいのね
records.en_original: Oh, really? So I guess you'll be fine without my help from now on.
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, really? So I guess you'll be fine without my help from now on.
records.en: Oh, really? So I guess you'll be fine without my help from now on.

records.jp: 二人ともやめて！　せっかく原種を倒せたんだから<CR>喧嘩しないで！
records.en_original: Cut it out! We've finally managed to defeat a Sephira! You should be celebrating, not arguing!
records.en_auxiliary: Cut it out! We've finally managed to defeat a Sephira! You should be celebrating, not arguing!
records.en: Both of you, stop! We finally defeated a Sephira.<CR>Don't start fighting now!

records.jp: 麻央、ありがとう。<CR>あなたのおかげで学校を守れた。お礼を言うよ
records.en_original: Thank you, Mao. We wouldn't have been able to protect the school without you. You have my gratitude.
records.en_auxiliary: Thank you, Mao. We wouldn't have been able to protect the school without you. You have my gratitude.
records.en: Thank you, Mao.<CR>We protected the school because of you.

records.jp: これからも一緒に戦ってくれる？
records.en_original: Will you keep fighting alongside us?
records.en_auxiliary: Will you keep fighting alongside us?
records.en: Will you keep fighting alongside us?

records.jp: ……どうしようかしら。<CR>その子が今までの暴言を謝ってくれたら考えてもいいけど
records.en_original: ...We'll see. Get that hotheaded witch over there to apologize and I might think about it.
records.en_auxiliary: ...We'll see. Get that hotheaded witch over there to apologize and I might think about it.
records.en: ...I'm not sure.<CR>If that girl apologizes for all the abuse, I might consider it.

records.jp: 冗談よ。そんな目で睨まないで。お互い今までのことを謝罪して、<CR>仲良しこよしで協同戦線とか気味が悪いわ
records.en_original: That was a joke. don't glare at me like that. Uch, it gives me the chills just thinking about working with you.
records.en_auxiliary: That was a joke. don't glare at me like that. Ugh, it gives me the chills just thinking about working with you.
records.en: I'm joking. Don't glare at me. The idea of us apologizing for everything,<CR>becoming all buddy-buddy and joining forces makes me sick.

records.jp: 学校を守るためには、相容れない者同士、割り切って協力するしか<CR>ない。そういうことでしょ？　いいわよ別にそれで。ただし……
records.en_original: But I'll need to cooperate with you to protect the school, right? I can live with that. However...
records.en_auxiliary: But I'll need to cooperate with you to protect the school, right? I can live with that. However...
records.en: To protect the school, people who can't see eye to eye have no choice<CR>but to set that aside and cooperate. That's the idea, right? Fine. But...

records.jp: ……ただし？
records.en_original: ...However?
records.en_auxiliary: ...However?
records.en: ...However?

records.jp: 一つだけ条件がある
records.en_original: I have one condition.
records.en_auxiliary: I have one condition.
records.en: I have one condition.

records.jp: 文化祭の演劇の主役、あなたがやりなさい
records.en_original: That you'll play the lead role at the school festival.
records.en_auxiliary: That you'll play the lead role at the culture festival.
records.en: You play the lead in the culture festival play.

records.en_original: Huh!?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh!?
records.en: Huh!?

records.jp: な、なんで？　だってまだオーディションの結果は
records.en_original: Wh-Why? But we haven't finished judging our audition.
records.en_auxiliary: Wh-why? Our auditions haven't even been judged yet.
records.en: Wh-Why? We haven't even heard the audition result yet...

records.jp: あんなもの、私をこの戦いに引き入れるための<CR>理由づけみたいなもんでしょ？
records.en_original: You only proposed that in order to get me involved in this battle, right?
records.en_auxiliary: You only proposed that in order to get me involved in this battle, right?
records.en: That was just an excuse<CR>to pull me into this fight, wasn't it?

records.jp: 目的は果たしたからいいじゃない。というか本気で私を<CR>主役に据えるなら、他の役も半端な演技じゃ許さないわよ
records.en_original: You got your way. Besides, if I were playing lead, I'd need my supporting cast to act a whole lot better.
records.en_auxiliary: You got your way. Besides, if I were playing the lead, I'd need my supporting cast to act a whole lot better.
records.en: We achieved the goal, so that's enough. And if I actually took the lead,<CR>I wouldn't tolerate half-hearted acting from the rest of you.

records.jp: 全員、授業なんか手につかないくらいしごいてあげるけど、それで<CR>もいいの？　みんなそこまでの覚悟があるようには見えないけど
records.en_original: Do you really want me to crack the whip over everyone until the festival? People would drop out right and left.
records.en_auxiliary: Do you really want me to crack the whip over everyone until the festival? People would drop out right and left.
records.en: I'd work everyone so hard they couldn't focus on class.<CR>Are you sure you want that? None of them look that committed.

records.jp: 麻央……
records.en_original: Mao...
records.en_auxiliary: Mao...
records.en: Mao...

records.jp: というわけであとはよろしく。<CR>私は引き揚げるわ。これ以上のなれ合いはまっぴらだし
records.en_original: Anyway, I leave this all in your hands. Now if you'll excuse me. I'm not interested in getting too friendly with you.
records.en_auxiliary: Anyway, I leave this all in your hands. Now if you'll excuse me. I'm not interested in getting too friendly with you.
records.en: Anyway, I'll leave the rest to you.<CR>I'm going home. I've had more than enough bonding for one day.

records.jp: 麻央！
records.en_original: Mao!
records.en_auxiliary: Mao!
records.en: Mao!

records.jp: 本当にいいの？<CR>あんなすごい演技、真剣に役と向き合わなきゃできないよ
records.en_original: Are you sure? You gave your audition your awll.
records.en_auxiliary: Are you sure? You gave your audition your all.
records.en: Are you really okay with that?<CR>You couldn't act that well without taking the role seriously.

records.jp: 本気で人魚姫をやるつもりで役作りしてたんでしょ？
records.en_original: You really planned on being the little mermaid, didn't you?
records.en_auxiliary: You really planned on being the Little Mermaid, didn't you?
records.en: You really built that role intending to play the Little Mermaid, didn't you?

records.jp: クラスのみんなも同じように感じてたと思う。<CR>なのに、勝負の結果も聞かず降りちゃっていいわけ？
records.en_original: I bet everyone else was as blown away as I was. Are you sure you want to step down without hearing the results?
records.en_auxiliary: I bet everyone else was as blown away as I was. Are you sure you want to step down without hearing the results?
records.en: I think everyone in class could tell.<CR>Are you really going to drop out without even hearing who won?

records.jp: 私、あんたのことが嫌いよ。白井。<CR>本当、虫ずが走るくらい。その甘ちゃんなところがかんに障る
records.en_original: I hate you, Shirai. You're so innocent it makes me cringe.
records.en_auxiliary: I hate you, Shirai. You're so innocent it makes me cringe.
records.en: I hate you, Shirai.<CR>You make my skin crawl. That naive side of you gets on my nerves.

records.jp: でも、この指輪からあなたの心が流れ込んできて、<CR>気持ちが感じられて、こんな世界もあるんだって思った
records.en_original: But when felt your heart flowing through this ring, I felt something I new to me.
records.en_auxiliary: But when your heart flowed into me through this ring, it felt like I was seeing a new world.
records.en: But your heart flowed into me through this ring,<CR>and when I felt it, I realized a world like that exists too.

records.jp: 温かくて、柔らかくて、穏やかで――
records.en_original: Something warm, soft, gentle--
records.en_auxiliary: So warm, soft, and gentle...
records.en: Warm, soft, peaceful...

records.jp: そんな心から生まれる演技がどんなものかと思っただけよ。<CR>まぁ技術面はお話にならないでしょうけど
records.en_original: I wonder what kind of performance someone like you would be capable of. Even if your technical acting is pathetic.
records.en_auxiliary: I wonder what kind of performance someone like you would be capable of. Even if your technical acting is pathetic.
records.en: I just wondered what kind of acting could come from a heart like that.<CR>Though I'm sure your technique is hopeless.

records.jp: 麻央……
records.en_original: Mao...
records.en_auxiliary: Mao...
records.en: Mao...

records.jp: せいぜい精進しなさい。本気であなたの世界を表現したいなら、<CR>ちゃんと相手に伝わるようにすることね
records.en_original: Anyway, do what you can. Just remember, acting is reaching out to the audience and drawing them into your world.
records.en_auxiliary: Anyway, do what you can. Just remember, acting is reaching out to the audience and drawing them into your world.
records.en: Keep practicing. If you truly want to express your world,<CR>make sure you can convey it to the person watching.

records.jp: なんか……変わった子だね
records.en_original: She's....interesting.
records.en_auxiliary: She's quite the character.
records.en: She's... kind of a strange girl.

records.jp: ……ヒナちゃん、よくあんな子のフラグメント、固定できたね
records.en_original: ...I still can't believe you actually succeeded in stabilizing her Fragment.
records.en_auxiliary: ...I still can't believe you actually succeeded in stabilizing her Fragment.
records.en: ...Hina-chan, I'm impressed you managed to stabilize a Fragment like hers.

records.jp: うん……でも、もう一度やっても、同じように分かり合える気がする
records.en_original: It's pretty incredible... But I do think we were meant to understand each other in the end.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah... But I think that even if we were to go through that again, we'd end up understanding each other.
records.en: Yeah... But even if I had to do it again, I think we'd understand each other the same way.

records.jp: （麻央は……もう一人の私なのかもしれない）
records.en_original: (Mao might be...another version of me.)
records.en_auxiliary: (Mao might be another version of me.)
records.en: (Mao might be... another me.)

records.jp: （周りに救ってくれる人がいなかった場合の私）
records.en_original: (I might've turned out like her if I didn't have anybody to save me.)
records.en_auxiliary: (I might've turned out like her if I didn't have anybody to save me.)
records.en: (Me, if I'd had no one around to save me.)

records.jp: （それでも世の中に絶望せず、前に向かって進み続けてる）
records.en_original: (But even in her world of despair, she hasn't lost hope. She's still marching forward.)
records.en_auxiliary: (But even in her world of despair, she hasn't lost hope. She's still marching forward.)
records.en: (And even then, she never gave in to despair. She kept moving forward.)

records.jp: （私だったら同じようにできたのかな）
records.en_original: (Would I have been able to do the same?)
records.en_auxiliary: (Would I have been able to do the same?)
records.en: (Would I have been able to do the same?)

records.jp: （今だって、足が治る希望があるから頑張っていられるけど）
records.en_original: (Even now, I'm driven by the hope that my leg will get better.)
records.en_auxiliary: (Even now, I'm driven by the hope that my leg will get better.)
records.en: (Even now, I can keep going because I have hope my leg will heal.)

records.jp: 何はともあれここまで来たね！
records.en_original: Well, the important thing is, we're finally strong enough!
records.en_auxiliary: Well, the important thing is, we're finally strong enough!
records.en: Anyway, we've come a long way!

records.jp: 原種も倒せるようになったし、あと少しで世界が救えるよ
records.en_original: Now that we can defeat Sephirot, we're that much closer to saving the world.
records.en_auxiliary: Now that we can defeat Sephira, we're that much closer to saving the world.
records.en: Now we can defeat the Sephira, and we're close to saving the world.

records.jp: う、うん
records.en_original: R-Right.
records.en_auxiliary: R-right.
records.en: R-Right.

records.jp: これで、あと３体か……
records.en_original: Only three left...
records.en_auxiliary: Only three left...
records.en: Three left...

records.jp: もうすぐ。もうすぐ足が――
records.en_original: And then, my leg will--
records.en_auxiliary: Pretty soon, my leg will—
records.en: Soon... Soon my leg will...
